summary: Iron Dome Acquisition I Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its IPO units may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares and redeemable warrants starting July 6, 2026. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-half of one redeemable warrant. No fractional warrants will be issued. The underlying securities will trade on Nasdaq under symbols IDAC (shares) and IDACW (warrants). This is a routine post-IPO administrative step enabling separate trading of securities initially bundled in units, not a special-situation event. No deal terms or strategic changes are involved.
